summary: This Form 8-K is a routine current report filed by Cycurion, Inc. to announce a scheduled Nasdaq listing hearing and reaffirm its commitment to maintaining its Nasdaq listing. The filing covers the company's request for a hearing to appeal a delisting determination related to the minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(1). The hearing is expected in August 2026. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change. It is purely a procedural update on a listing compliance matter.
